title: Scroll Velocity
description: Marquee whose speed and direction follow your scrolling.

a11y.motion: The row stays still at its starting position and does not react to scrolling.
a11y.keyboard: Nothing is interactive by default. If children contain links, only the first copy is focusable, and the marquee pauses while the pointer or focus is inside it.
a11y.screenReader: Only the first copy of the children is exposed; the three duplicates are aria-hidden and inert.
